newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers firmer on more enquiries.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers firmer on more enquiries.

text.p: Singapore bunker quotes edged higher on Tuesday in line with the firm cargo and swaps market and traders said enquiries improved slightly.

"Some shipowners started to make enquiries because they worry prices may go even higher," said one trader. June fuel oil swaps rose to $102.00/$103.00 from Monday's $101.50/102.50. Another trader said most shipowners were still unwilling to pay high prices.
The 180-cst bunker was quoted at $108/$109 and the 380-cst was at $101/$102. MDO and gas oil were quoted at about $190/$193 and $205/$210 respectively. - Singapore Newsroom (65 8703571)
